name: Ancient Ooze — total mana value of other creatures you control
notes: Memory: project_ancient_ooze_mana_value_cda_2026-06-05. No CDA was emitted for 'total mana value of' so the Ooze was 0/0. Here: Grizzly Bears (MV 2) plus Vampire Nighthawk (MV 3) = 5; Sol Ring (noncreature) and the opponent's Serra Angel (MV 5) must not count, and the Ooze's own MV 7 is excluded by 'other'.
